description: Get the report of a repository investigation started with anyforge_investigate_repository that came back with status "running". Waits up to ~40s per call. Status "done" carries the report; "running" means call this again with the same jobId (it never re-runs the investigation). An error means the investigation failed or the jobId is unknown/expired (investigations are kept for a day). Requires read scope.
name: anyforge_get_repository_investigation
title: Get repository investigation
